#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""TPS_PortMap_Single.py 안에 내장된 웹앱 파일을 폴더로 꺼냅니다.

사용: python scripts/extract_web.py [출력폴더]   (기본: site)
"""
import importlib.util
import pathlib
import sys

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
SOURCE = ROOT / 'TPS_PortMap_Single.py'


def main():
    out = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else ROOT / 'site')
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('tps_portmap', SOURCE)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    if '/index.html' not in module.ASSETS:
        raise SystemExit('index.html이 ASSETS에 없습니다.')
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for path, payload in module.ASSETS.items():
        target = out / path.lstrip('/')
        target.write_bytes(payload)
        print(f'{target} ({len(payload):,} bytes)')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
